title: A DROP IS NEVER LOST ON ITS WAY
why: Found by the code comb of 2026-10-06: when the host extracted or died and kept the world running for the party, a teammate drop was refused by the host (its raid was over) and the item, already out of the backpack, was gone; and a linked window that had lost its host link dropped items into nowhere. The spectating host now makes the pile, and with no host link the pile is made locally as in solo.
now: Dropping an item for your teammate always leaves it on the ground, even after the host has extracted.

edits.replacement: if(typeof G==='undefined'||!G||(G.over&&G!==NET.specG)||typeof netContHost!=='function'||!netContHost()) return 'down';   // v16.xx: a spectating host still runs the boxes
